showcase: Every tap opens your card. Every lead lands in your pipeline.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to your workspace.
login.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to carry on where you were.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Free to start. Your first card takes a few minutes.
register.name: Your name
register.organizationHint: The name of your workspace. You can change it later.

google.failed: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again, or use your email and password.
google.otherAccount: This email is already linked to a different Google account. Sign in with that one, or with your password.
google.unavailable: Google sign-in isn't available right now. Use your email instead.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.
errors.suspended: This account has been suspended. Ask your workspace owner to restore it.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.passwordShort: Use at least 8 characters for the password.
errors.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.linkInvalid: This link has expired or has already been used.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.tooManyUntil: Too many attempts. Try again after {{time}}.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you sign in with, and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentTo: If an account exists for <1>{{email}}</1>, a link to reset its password is on its way. The link works for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You'll use it to sign in from now on.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.invalidBody: Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one.

invite.title: Join your team
invite.subtitle: Choose a password to accept the invitation. You'll use it to sign in.
invite.name: Your name
invite.invalidBody: Open the link from the invitation email again, or ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
invite.expiredBody: Ask whoever invited you to send a new invitation.
